continuous_self_learning_scope: blocked controller-side schema aggregation; model weights out of scope.

controller_only_evidence_summary.interpretation: Current evidence is controller-only and cached-artifact based. Exp 3060 adds a process-level trace schema so future self-learning pilots store solver signals before claiming any stronger learning result.

field_principles.allowed_edit_targets: controller-side and model-weight learning must be separated
field_principles.forbidden_claims: capstone wording must not outrun evidence
field_principles.inference_substrate: schema work must declare no live model inference
field_principles.solver_self_model_trace_ready: self-learning pilots need a process trace schema
field_principles.source_artifacts: schema decisions must trace to prior evidence
field_principles.trace_schema: learned updates must have machine-readable provenance
field_principles.validation_rules: self-learning failure modes must be predeclared

forbidden_claims: model-weight learning, model-weight mutation, or native model retraining
live LLM inference, live solver inference, or live model adaptation
broad autonomous self-learning beyond controller-side process traces
KAN model-weight training or KAN structural learning from this schema
promotion from self-confirming labels without independent exact authority

fields.description: stable unique ID for one solver-feedback trace
fields.name: trace_id

fields.description: solver prompt text/ref, normalized input variables, input hash, and prompt family
fields.name: solver_prompt_input

fields.description: family ID, held-out family ID, verifier type, and exact authority reference
fields.name: exact_constraint_family

fields.description: solver correction set with violated constraints and suggested assignments
fields.name: correction_set

fields.description: nodes, edges, contradiction rate before/after, and graph hash update
fields.name: contradiction_graph_update

fields.description: controller-side target, operation, before/after hashes, and source trace IDs
fields.name: controller_edit

fields.description: rollback decision, reason, comparator signal, threshold, and count delta
fields.name: rollback_decision

fields.description: delayed replay IDs, minimum lag, metric name, and regression threshold
fields.name: delayed_regression_window

fields.description: artifact path, schema, checksum, source experiment ID, and ready field
fields.name: source_artifact

record_level_constraints: controller_edit.target MUST be one of allowed_edit_targets

validation_rules.name: self_confirming_labels

validation_rules.detects: train/update families overlapping held-out or delayed-regression families
validation_rules.name: family_leakage

validation_rules.detects: trace rows lacking an exact SAT/SMT/solver authority reference
